summary: Episodes 38-144 do NOT reach chapters 130-333 as the task brief guessed: the 145-episode anime stops at chapter 240 (existing ep145 anchor), so the target range actually spans roughly chapters 89-238. The adaptation is linear inside each football match but heavily re-ordered between them, and it contains two long anime-original arcs (Cream Puff Cup, eps 89-95; Death Game, eps 97-105) plus a recap (ep 96) that our rows all still carry as type=canon. The single most useful structural source is the fandom Story Arcs page, which gives a clean arc lattice (Fall Tournament ch 89-111 = eps 37-54; Kyoshin ch 112-127 = eps 55-63; Seibu ch 128-150 = eps 64-74; Bando ch 151-167 = eps 75-87; Shinryuji ch 168-200 = eps 106-119; Ojo ch 201-240 = eps 129-145); it is corroborated chapter-by-chapter by exact JAPANESE episode-title/chapter-title matches (ep 42=ch 98, ep 56=ch 114, ep 58=ch 116, ep 79=ch 154, ep 80=ch 156, ep 113=ch 180, ep 130=ch 210, ep 131=ch 211, ep 140=ch 228, ep 142=ch 235). Two surprises: episode 101 sits INSIDE the Death Game filler block yet is straight canon (ch 168-169, confirmed by both fandom chapter pages), and Musashi's return - manga ch 141-142, inside the Seibu game - is deferred by the anime to eps 82-83 during the Bando game, while ch 54-57 (Musashi's introduction, skipped in the NASA arc) is backfilled at ep 43 and ch 100 is backfilled at ep 88. The Wikipedia chapter list was parsed line-wise off the explicit {{Numbered list|start=N}} anchors and cross-checked against fandom chapter pages and the stored volume table: 333 chapters, no gaps, all 37 volume boundaries identical to the context file, so the known numbering-shift trap did not bite. animefillerguide (the origin of our stored '* Filler' title suffixes) is demonstrably wrong on this series and was not used as a sole source for anything.

repairs.why: OUT OF MY ASSIGNED RANGE but it anchors the left edge of it, so flagging rather than silently working around it. ep 37 cannot end at ch 79: the fandom ch-88 page carries the reverse mapping 88th Down -> Episode 36, the Death March arc is ch 72-88 = eps 29-36, and the Fall Tournament Saga is ch 89-111 = eps 37-54. Wikipedia's ep-36 summary is the Las Vegas casino (ch 87 'Las Vegas, City of Lights' + 88 'Black Jack Is 21') and ep 37 is the return to Japan plus Sakuraba's breakdown (ch 89 + 91 'Reach for the Stars'). The existing value is afg-derived from a table that has no chapter data past ep 21.

structure.notes: OUR numbering matched the fandom episode-page numbering 1:1 across the whole range - every fandom 'Episode N' title equals the stored title for N (eps 38-145 checked mechanically), so open flag #830's suspected numbering offset is NOT present here; the stored titles simply carry an animefillerguide '* Filler' suffix baked into the title string (e.g. 'The Ghost Is Sealed?! * Filler'), which is a cosmetic data defect, not an offset. The anime is 145 episodes; our entry holds 155 rows because of EXTRAS_ADOPTED (10 specials beyond AniList's 145) - all anchors above use OUR cumulative numbering, which for 1-145 is identical to broadcast numbering, and nothing was joined positionally. Fandom's Episode pages 146-155 do not exist, so the 10 adopted extras are unsourced on that wiki; animefillerguide's table numbers its last row '155.' for 'Everybody, Let's Play American Football!', which is the broadcast ep 145 - anyone joining AFG by row number will mis-place the finale, and the stored ep155 -> ch 240 (mu) anchor looks like exactly that mistake surfacing. Arc lattice (fandom Story Arcs page, corroborated throughout): Death March ch 72-88 = eps 29-36; Fall Tournament Saga ch 89-111 = eps 37-54; Kyoshin Poseidons ch 112-127 = eps 55-63; Seibu Wild Gunmen ch 128-150 = eps 64-74; Bando Spiders ch 151-167 = eps 75-87; Cream Puff Cup (anime-only) eps 88-95; Death Game (anime-only) eps 97-105; Shinryuji Nagas ch 168-200 = eps 106-119; Ojo White Knights ch 201-240 = eps 129-145; Hakushu Dinosaurs (241-274), Christmas Bowl (275-304) and Youth World Cup (305-333) are Manga Only. The Wikipedia chapter list was parsed off explicit {{Numbered list|start=N}} markers rather than by counting list items - the documented shift trap - and the result (333 chapters, zero gaps, 37 volumes) reproduces the stored volume boundaries exactly and agrees with every volume field found on fandom chapter pages (ch 7 v1, 24 v3, 34 v4, 47 v6, 88 v10, 103 v12, 109 v13, 168/169 v19).

flags_for_sean: ep 37 repair (79 -> 91) is outside my assigned range 38-144. It is well evidenced but I did not want to anchor ep 38 on top of a stored value I believe is wrong; if the repair is declined, eps 38-40 will interpolate from 79 and read low by roughly a volume. Repairs on this series land on afg-tier rows, so per the hikaru rule the row must flip to source=manual or the next afg re-derive erases it.

animefillerguide is the origin of our stored titles for this series (the '* Filler' suffixes match its table character for character) and its filler flags are demonstrably wrong here: it marks eps 52, 54, 101, 106, 107, 120, 124 as filler, yet fandom chapter pages carry explicit reverse mappings for several of them (109th Down -> Episode 54; 168th and 169th Down -> Episode 101) and Wikipedia's volume summaries confirm all seven as adapted. I used AFG only as a corroborating third source and never as sole truth.

ep 88 ('Deimon's Halftime Show'): unresolved type. It adapts a real chapter (ch 100 'The Comic Strip Halftime Show'), which argues canon, but it is a chibi 4-koma interlude that advances nothing and both AFG and Wikipedia treat it as a break episode. I left the stored type alone, issued no anchor, and recorded the ch-100 link as a side_story annotation. If it stays canon it will interpolate between ep 87 (ch 167) and ep 101 (ch 168) - harmless either way.

eps 109-110 look anime-original to me (the Monta/Ikkyu duel and Unsui's motivation are in-game material in the manga, ch 185/188, staged here before kickoff) and AFG marks them filler, but the fandom Shinryuji arc page includes them in its eps 106-119 range, so I did not assert a type correction on one source plus inference. Same for ep 51 and ep 66, and for ep 39 which Wikipedia describes as 'a quick review of the previous 38 episodes' yet AFG does NOT flag.

ep 59 vs ep 62: ep 59's Japanese title is ch 121 exactly, but Kyoshin's High Wave (ch 120) is not shown until ep 62. I anchored ep 59 -> 121 at medium and left 60-62 unanchored rather than force a monotone reading; if Sean prefers strict monotonicity, dropping the ep 59 anchor costs nothing since ep 63 -> 126 holds the arc's right edge.
The task brief's chapter estimate (~130-333) was wrong by a wide margin. The anime never passes ch 240, so eps 38-144 span roughly ch 89-238; nothing in the range can be anchored above 240.
